descriptionChirho: A proper noun referring to Zeboiim (also spelled Zeboim), one of the five cities of the plain destroyed alongside Sodom and Gomorrah (Gen 10:19; 14:2,8; Deut 29:23; Hos 11:8), and possibly a valley location in Benjamin (1 Sam 13:18; Neh 11:34). All three clusters are grammatical variants of the same toponym: bare citation 'Zeboiim/Zeboim' (S129416), conjunctive 'and Zeboiim/y Zeboim' (S129418), and prepositional 'like Zeboiim/como Zeboim' (S129420). Multilingual renderings confirm a single referent: 'तसेवोयिम/सबोयीम' (hin), 'صَبُويِيمَ' (arb), '스보임' (kor), 'Seboimu' (swa). Prepositional and conjunctive prefixes are syntactic, not semantic.
